name: Ca song nuong
summary: Horse mackerel grilled on charcoal with salt and chili, then wrapped in rice paper with herbs and vegetables. The meat is aromatic and sweet, meatier and less fishy than most seafood.
origin: Phu Quoc. Both accounts are Vietnam National Authority of Tourism.
texture: The specialty-seafood account says the meat is meatier than other seafood and tastes less fishy. It also says the fish is challenging to catch.
taste: Salt and chili, then aromatic and sweet, on the specialty-seafood account. The nature account does not print a seasoning.
howToEat: Season it with salt and chili, then wrap the fish with herbs and vegetables in rice paper.
Order it for lunch or dinner by the water.
seoTitle: Ca song nuong — grilled Trachurus on Phu Quoc
seoDescription: Cá sòng nướng is horse mackerel grilled with salt and chili and rolled in rice paper with herbs, sweet and less fishy than most seafood.
